## What, why and prior learning {#dc4-purpose .dc-lesson }

<div class="dc-intentions">
<div class="dc-intention"><strong>What?</strong><p>We are learning to combine differentiation rules to find derivatives, tangents and normals.</p></div>
<div class="dc-intention"><strong>Why?</strong><p>Model vibrations that gradually die away and find how fast the object is moving.</p></div>
<div class="dc-intention dc-prior"><strong>Prior learning</strong><p>Exponential, logarithmic and trigonometric derivatives; product, quotient and chain rules; straight-line equations.</p></div></div>

::: notes
Success criterion, revisited near the end: I can select the required differentiation rules and use the resulting gradient to find a tangent or normal. Derivatives were covered in Lessons 1–3. Straight-line equations are prerequisite recall; tangent and normal equations receive an explicit recap later. Keep this opening brief.
:::
